facts.scope_summary: Design, development, and implementation of a new Vancouver Civic Theatres website plus ongoing post-implementation maintenance, support, and hosting services.
bid_prerequisites: Acceptance of the Legal Terms and Conditions is required prior to proposal submission.
required_submission_components: Legal company name/trade name and full business address
Procurement key contact name, telephone, and email
Annex 1 - Scope of Work Questionnaire as PDF with no pricing
Annex 2 - Technical Requirements as completed Excel
Annex 3 - Functional Requirements as completed Excel
Annex 4 - Financial Proposal as completed Excel
Certificate of Existing Insurance signed by broker/agent
Broker/agent letter addressing ability to comply with Form of Agreement insurance requirements
Declaration of Supplier Code of Conduct Compliance
Key-personnel privacy form(s) when CV/employment/qualification information is included
Subcontractor form when subcontractors are proposed
Form of Agreement amendment form when amendments are proposed
Actual/potential conflict-of-interest and City business-relationship disclosure
Valid WorkSafeBC registration or accepted equivalent/out-of-BC coverage evidence as applicable

service_line.description: Total Project Fee for the initial Two-Year Contract: Year 1 Design, Development & Implementation and Year 2 Ongoing Maintenance & Support (CMS & Hosting Environment), exclusive of GST and PST

limitations: The public event export lists the three buyer attachments but does not expose their contents without Supplier Portal login.
